# The new panel is vscode/app/: a pure model (model.js), pure HTML (html.js) and a thin webview glue…

The new panel is vscode/app/: a pure model (model.js), pure HTML (html.js) and a thin webview glue (panel.js) re-rendered on every move; VS Code theme variables only; the old panel stays beside it until #201

Five areas (g h/t/d/e/s) and More; / or ctrl/cmd+k opens Search and Ask; the waiting count in the top bar. The reading layout: sections left, page middle (summary first; a section's first two paragraphs, the rest folded once), "On this page" right; one column under 900 px. Docs reads Project, Capabilities (a pill per capability), ADRs, Glossary, Out of scope and the wiki. Tasks, Edits and Setup point at the old panel until #197 and #199. The launcher's first row opens it (imprimatur.app.open). A strict CSP: only the nonce's script runs.
